messages:
Nora: thinking about adding a "capacity ack" step to autofallback in the console. idea: if fallback would hit dedicated capacity, require an explicit ack with headroom token. thoughts?
Jay: yes, otherwise we surprise infra. UI should show exact headroom needed and current available.
Eve: also include a "reserve temp headroom" button that creates a short-lived reservation so operator can enable fallback immediately. reservation writes to audit.
Nora: reservation TTL should default to 15m. operator must supply reason. reservation failure should block enable.
Jay: telemetry: when fallback activates, emit a single event with event_id linking policy, reservation_id (if any), and metric snapshot. rollout-bot should post that link.
build-bot: reservation created res-2100109999-1 by Nora (ttl=900s). audit://res-2100109999-1
Eve: UX: composer shows a compact "compatibility checklist": api-compat, token-fit, quota-check. any unchecked item disables the enable button.
Nora: also add a "force enable" with two-step confirmation for emergencies; this should still write to audit and require team approver later.
Jay: store policies with normalized IDs and keep a small sample of redacted inputs in the audit for postmortem. default redact=true.
Eve: agreed. i'll draft the minimal API contract for reservation and audit links and post it in the design thread.
Nora: thanks — can you ping when it's up? i'll iterate the modal copy after that.
